$comment: Каркас контракту (T-001). Схеми payload-ів додаються разом з реалізацією команд (T-004/T-005 і далі).

error_envelope.$comment: T-007: кожна помилка команди — цей конверт. Коди стабільні: додавати можна, змінювати/видаляти — ні. Rust: domain::error::CoreError; TS: ui/src/ipc/types.ts CoreErrorPayload.

app.health.$comment: Diagnostics: versions, module states, IPC counters (T-009); elevated + scanPlans (T-028); elevation {status,offerPending,message…} (T-034); quarantineVolumes [{volume,available,reason?}] (T-089: reap blocked with visible reason)

app.state.$comment: Read-only authoritative UI snapshot after webview reload: {cleanup,scanRunning,settings,volumes:[{volume,capacityBytes,freeBytes}],quarantine:{heldCount,heldBytes}} (volumes+quarantine — T-106 Sidebar); never starts a scan

app.ping.$comment: Діагностика: payload {delayMs?, fail?} -> {version, delayedMs}; fail=true повертає error_envelope (invalid_argument)

app.test_stream.$comment: Діагностика каналу подій: payload {count?, intervalMs?} -> ack {accepted} ОДРАЗУ; далі count подій app.test у фоні

app.request_elevation.$comment: UAC relaunch (runas) → {status: started|already_elevated, willExit}; cancel UAC → cancelled; started exits process after reply

app.decline_elevation.$comment: Session refuse: no re-prompt this process; walk path (T-028); → {declined:true, offerPending:false}

scan.start.$comment: payload {volumes?: string[]} -> ack {accepted, volumeCount}; work + scan.progress in background

scan.stop.$comment: cooperative cancel; ack {stopping}; scanner stops ≤500ms; partial index kept

category.top_candidates.$comment: {categoryId, limit?:1..6=4} → {categoryId, topCandidates:[{id,kind,sizeBytes}]}; Keep приховано, сортовано за розміром спаданням

category.all_candidates.$comment: categoryId (string) → [{id,kind,sizeBytes}] усіх кандидатів категорії; живить кнопку [Позначити все] на safe-to-bulk рядках

category.window.$comment: {categoryId} → Candidate[] (id,path,kind,unit,sizeBytes,lastAccessAt,createdAt,decision,explanation,alsoIn); Keep приховано, сортовано за розміром спаданням; живить віртуалізовану сітку категорії. alsoIn заповнюється з T-121 (маркер перетину категорій) — усі категорії кандидата, крім запитаної; порожньо якщо файл лише в одній. createdAt — null якщо Core не зміг прочитати дату створення (T-125).

category.set_threshold.$comment: {categoryId,key,value:u64} → AppSettings; редагований поріг лише large_files/old_files/forgotten_videos/archives (предикатні детектори T-039..042); делегує в той самий шлях, що й settings.set (T-092/T-093) — гарячий перерахунок з індексу без рескану, подія settings.changed

candidate.mark.$comment: payload {candidateId?, path?, marked?:bool} → {updated, decision}; Marked/Undecided on file → all categories; emits cleanup.total_updated

candidate.keep.$comment: payload {candidateId?, path?, unkeep?:bool} → {updated, decision}; Keep hides file in every category; persists via index upsert

candidate.reveal_in_explorer.$comment: payload {candidateId:u64} → null; open Explorer with the file selected (explorer.exe /select,"path"); fire-and-forget, Err only if the candidate is unknown or the process failed to spawn

candidate.batch.$comment: {candidateIds:u64[]} → Candidate[] (same shape as category.window); looks up arbitrary ids across ALL categories via HotIndex, not scoped to one — Reap Bar/selectionStore (T-108) only track candidateId+sizeBytes across the whole session, so the REAP confirmation overlay needs a category-agnostic way to fetch full path/kind/decision for whatever's currently marked. Unknown ids silently drop, not an error.

reap.execute.$comment: {candidateIds:u64[]} → {batchId,reapedCount,reapedBytes}; wraps TransactionalReaper (T-079) — durable in_flight→atomic move→quarantined per candidate, expected_identity re-read live at call time (size exact, mtime to the second — the precision the hot index actually captured, T-024/T-057) before trusting the freshly-read precise identity for TransactionalReaper's own strict FILETIME check (T-086); mismatch → file_changed and the whole batch stops (no partial moves past the first failure). Reaped candidates get Decision::Keep applied via the same apply_decision_hot/apply_and_emit_totals path as candidate.keep (T-057), hiding them from every category in this session. Empty candidateIds / none resolve to a local volume → invalid_argument. Feeds the REAP overlay's (T-135) progress + "X ГБ у Quarantine · [Скасувати]" toast.

reap.undo_batch.$comment: {batchId:u64} → RestoreOutcome[] {entryId,originalPath,restoredPath,usedSuffix}; wraps QuarantineRestorer::undo_batch (T-081) — restores every entry in the batch, emits quarantine.restored per entry. Powers the reap toast's [Скасувати] action (T-138).

quarantine.restore_batch.$comment: {entryIds:u64[]} → RestoreOutcome[] {entryId,originalPath,restoredPath,usedSuffix}; wraps QuarantineRestorer (T-080) — FS move + manifest→Restored + audit; emits quarantine.restored per entry (message set when usedSuffix). Empty entryIds / unknown entryId → invalid_argument. Single-entry batch = R-key/button restore (T-132); multi-entry = future bulk undo (T-081).

quarantine.reveal_path.$comment: {path} → null; open Explorer with the file selected (same primitive as candidate.reveal_in_explorer, T-125, but by raw path — a just-restored file isn't necessarily a HotIndex candidate). Feeds the restore toast's [Показати] action.

quarantine.purge.$comment: {entryIds?:u64[]} → {purgedCount,purgedBytes}; entryIds present = selective destroy ("Знищити позначені"), absent/null = "Спорожнити все" (ManualPurgeSelection::All, T-083). Wraps ManualPurger (T-083) — validation + real file deletion + manifest→Purged + audit; empty entryIds → invalid_argument. Emits quarantine.changed (same payload as TTL-sweeper T-082) so Sidebar badge stays live. Hard confirmation dialog is UI-only, not enforced here — the only such confirmation in the product (docs/ui.md §7).

quarantine.window.$comment: {} → QuarantineEntry[] (id,batchId,originalPath,sizeBytes,quarantinedAt,expiresAt,status); лише status=quarantined (той самий фільтр, що й бейдж T-106), сортовано за найближчим автознищенням (Core default) — повний пікер сортування клієнтський, T-131

quarantine.thumbnail.$comment: {entryId, maxEdge?} → {status: cached|unavailable, dataUrl?}; та сама мініатюра, що й preview.thumbnail (T-120), але джерело — сурогатний шлях карантину, не HotIndex (файл уже переміщено, T-088); генерація синхронна в межах виклику (без P1-черги/preview.ready — client не може наперед відтворити сурогатний шлях для кореляції події)

settings.set.$comment: {settings: AppSettings} → saved AppSettings; invalid field returns invalid_argument with field path; atomic temp+fsync+rename

preview.thumbnail.$comment: {candidateId, maxEdge?:16..1024=160} → {status: cached|scheduled|unavailable, dataUrl?}; cached — data:image/png;base64 synchronous; scheduled — P1 job, final delivery via preview.ready event keyed by path; unavailable — folder unit (no single file). First preview.* command — bridges Core pipeline T-067..T-076 to UI.

preview.scrub_strip.$comment: {candidateId, maxEdge?:64..1920=480, frames?:2..20=16} → {frameCount, frames: data:image/png;base64[]} in timeline order; empty array = not a video / ffmpeg unavailable. Not disk-cached (raw scrub cache format from T-068 isn't self-describing for dims yet); UI client-side cache covers repeat hovers.

preview.large.$comment: {candidateId, maxEdge?:64..4096=1024} → {status: sharp_from_cache|draft_then_sharp_scheduled|sharp_scheduled_only|unavailable, quality?: draft|sharp, dataUrl?}; wraps TwoStagePreviewer (T-073) — draft synchronously if cached (<100ms), sharp generated as P0 job and delivered via preview.ready {kind:"large_sharp"} if not already synchronous; also records prefetch demand (T-146 hit rate)

preview.prefetch.$comment: {candidateIds:u64[], anchorIndex:usize, motion:i32} → {scheduledCount, scheduledPaths, metrics:{demands,cacheHits,scheduled,hitRate}}; integrates PreviewPrefetcher T-075 — P2 warm of next 2–3 tiles by cursor trajectory so Live Preview draft is ready (right pane never white). max 256 ids; motion=0 no-op

duplicates.groups.$comment: {} → {state: DuplicatesCascadeEvent shape, groups: MarkedDuplicateGroup[] (size,contentHash:hex string,members:[{candidateId,path,role,keep}],keepId,policy,potentialReclaimBytes)}; last cached result of the post-scan duplicate cascade (T-058..066); empty/idle before the first scan that found ≥2 comparable files. Feeds the Duplicates group-row screen instead of category.window.

app.test.$comment: Діагностичний потік {seq, of} — породжується командою app.test_stream

app.test_counter.$comment: T-006 diagnostic stream: aggregated counter payload {delta, total}, emitted no more than 10/s

scan.journal_stale.$comment: USN journal overwritten/stale → {volume, reason, message, fullRescan:true}; auto full rescan follows (orchestrator T-033)

index.updated.$comment: Change Monitor live tick: {volume, created, modified, deleted, renamed}; UI refreshes category totals (T-055)

scan.progress.$comment: {volume, strategy, phase, filesIndexed, volumeIndex, volumeCount, done, cancelled}

cleanup.total_updated.$comment: Live unique total during scan: {reclaimableBytes, uniqueFiles, categories:[{id,totalBytes,itemCount,safety,countUnit}]}; ≤10/s (T-006)

category.updated.$comment: Per-category rollup (same shape as CleanupTotal.categories[]); emitted with cleanup.total_updated flush

duplicates.cascade_updated.$comment: Duplicate cascade progress: {phase, confidence: preliminary|confirmed, refining, reclaimableBytes, groupCount, filesInGroups, cancelled}. After stage 2: preliminary+refining; after stage 3: confirmed, refining=false. Emitted from scan_runtime post-scan (T-126) — same shape as duplicates.groups' state field.

preview.ready.$comment: {path, kind: "thumbnail"|"large_sharp", dataUrl} — delivers a background-generated preview: "thumbnail" (T-120, P1 job) after preview.thumbnail returned status=scheduled; "large_sharp" (T-124, P0 job) after preview.large's synchronous response only had draft (or nothing). Matched client-side by path.

quarantine.restored.$comment: {entryId, originalPath, restoredPath, usedSuffix, message?}; usedSuffix=true → message = warning about occupied original path; feeds restore toast (T-132)

quarantine.changed.$comment: {purgedCount, purgedBytes, heldBytes, thresholdExceeded, message?}; thresholdExceeded emits visible volume warning

quarantine.entry_expired.$comment: {entryId, originalPath, sizeBytes}; emitted after TTL purge succeeds and manifest is confirmed
